services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: From interior walls and ceilings to exterior masonry and timber, we handle every painting and decorating job with precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Professional painting of walls, ceilings, and trim. We prep, prime, and finish to a high standard—your home looks fresh and lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for masonry, timber, and rendering. Protects your property and curb appeal for years.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Bold colours, textures, and finishes that transform a room. We advise on colour matching and help you get the look right.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and architrave painted to a professional finish. Includes sanding and undercoat for lasting results.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Preparation
services.desc: Quality wallpaper hanging and removal, plus thorough wall prep. We ensure patterns align and seams are invisible.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial painting. We work around your schedule and keep disruption to a minimum.

about_pullquote: We don't cut corners—every wall gets prepped properly, every coat applied with care.
about_para_1: S&S Painting and Contractors has been transforming homes and businesses across Bristol for over 12 years. We started because we were frustrated by shoddy paintwork and overpriced quotes. Today, we're one of Bristol's most reliable decorators, with a reputation built on thorough prep, quality materials, and honest pricing.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we turn up on time, listen to what you want, and deliver results that last. Whether it's a single bedroom or a whole house renovation, we bring the same professionalism and care to every job. We're local, we're insured, and we stand behind our work.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About S&S

reviews.text: Had the whole house redecorated. From the initial quote to the final brushstroke, everything was smooth and professional. Rooms look brilliant, and they left the place spotless. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: Exterior painting was a nightmare job—damp patches, old render falling off. These lads sorted it all, primed it properly, and now the front of the house looks brand new. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Did my daughter's bedroom and the kitchen. Steve and the team were tidy, punctual, and actually listened when I changed my mind about the colour halfway through. That's service.
reviews.author: James H.
